additional_info.subject: 0459395 - ID0459395-DC/Si-D/DE-[MP/R0 170002833]Charging power toggling CRM:00472000588
additional_info.body:
Dear Benjamin,
Thank you for bringing this matter to our attention, and I apologize for the delay in my response.
I have conducted a thorough analysis of the reported charging session and reviewed the charger's performance data over the past several weeks. While the session in question does exhibit some atypical characteristics, I want to assure you that our system was responding appropriately to the EV's target current requirements at the time.
To ensure complete accuracy, I have also escalated this case to our R&D team for additional technical review and validation of my findings.
Key Findings:
The maximum current output consistently exceeded the target current, which is the expected behavior when our charger is actively responding to the vehicle's current requests.
I have reviewed other sessions from this charger and have not identified similar current curves in our historical data.
Based on my experience with charger-related faults, issues typically manifest as a reduction in maximum current below the target threshold. This pattern is not present in your case.
Next Steps:
To better assist you, could you please clarify whether you have encountered this behavior in additional charging sessions, or if this is an isolated incident? This information will help us determine whether further investigation is warranted.
At this time, I have not identified any fault with the charger itself. However, I remain available should you wish to discuss this matter further.
With best regards,
Joao Francisco Louro Cardoso
Siemens S.A.
SI E CS SD L3
201, Avenida 25 de Abril
2845-547 Corroios, Portugal
